name: tile_floor_library
prompt:
Flat cartoon illustration for a whimsical retro video game. Thick cocoa-brown ink outlines, flat fills, slightly wobbly hand-drawn lines, risograph print texture with colors a little off-register. Limited palette: cream, cocoa brown, teal, mustard yellow, coral, moss green, lilac. Silly, warm, friendly, a little strange. In the spirit of EarthBound, Katamari Damacy, Chicory, and Untitled Goose Game. Not realistic, not 3D rendered, not painterly, not gothic, not dark, no gradients, no text, no watermark, no border.

Mustard herringbone parquet with cocoa seams.

Seamlessly tileable square texture seen from directly above, edges wrap perfectly, no visible seam, quiet and low-contrast so objects read on top of it.
Match the style of the attached reference sheet exactly. The attachment is only a style reference; output ONLY the requested single asset, no sheet or extra studies. Output dimensions 1024×1024. Use only cream #F6E7C8, cocoa #4A2C2A, teal #2A9D8F, mustard #E9B44C, coral #F07167, moss #7FB069, lilac #B8A1E3. Lilac only for Maria or explicitly specified lilac liquid. No black or white. Flat fills, few marks, thick wobbly outlines, readable at 64 pixels, no gradients, no highlights or cast shadows. Do not add spade symbols or any motifs absent from the requested asset. No letters or text. FULL BLEED texture filling the entire square, not a floating swatch, no outer border or margin, no perspective. Repeating motifs continue across opposite edges at identical positions. Use sparse larger shapes and restrained contrast.
EDIT TARGET image2, image3 is diagnostic only. Fix all discontinuities seen at the 3x3 joins. Redraw the herringbone as a perfectly periodic pattern, exactly same phase on each opposite edge. Output ONE tile, not diagnostic grid. Retain mustard planks cocoa seams and hand-drawn style. Do not change palette or add borders.
